description_en: Retrieves the default job template of the default workspace
description_zh: 您可以通过GetGlobalDeploymentDefaults来获得默认的工作空间的作业模版
name: GetGlobalDeploymentDefaults

parameters.help_en: The name of the default namespace
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en:
The workspace ID where the job resides. You can obtain the workspace ID by using one of the following methods:
Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193848.html.
View the workspace details in the development console of fully managed Flink
parameters.help_zh:
作业所在的工作空间ID。您可以通过以下任意一种方式获取：
通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193848.html获取。
在Flink全托管开发控制台工作空间详情中获取
parameters.name: workspace
